title: Spiny Toad
move_pattern: Cycles: Protruding Spikes → Spike Explosion → Tongue Lash
notes: The Spiny Toad cycles between gaining and removing Thorns. On the first turn, it gains 5 Thorns with Protruding Spikes, becoming spiky. On the second turn, it explodes for 25 damage while losing the 5 Thorns. On the third turn, it uses a normal tongue attack for 19 damage. This pattern repeats. The monster has separate animations for its spiky and unspiked states.
